notes: Shopify storefront, robots.txt fully open (Allow: / for User-agent: *, no Claude-specific disallow) -> HTTP-first tier (curl + Shopify sitemap/products.json) was sufficient, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. Discovery: fetched sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (629 collection URLs total), grepped for the full seasonal vocabulary (Christmas/Xmas, Diwali, Halloween, Holi, Rakhi/Raksha Bandhan, Eid, Navratri, Dussehra, Ganesh Chaturthi, Janmashtami, Pongal, Onam, Durga Puja, Karwa Chauth, Makar Sankranti, Baisakhi, Valentine, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year, Mother's/Father's Day, festive/festival/holiday/celebrate/santa/independence/republic-day), then checked live main-nav mega-menu (top-level items are only Sale/Living Room/Bedroom/Dining/Decor/Kitchen/Furnishing/Gifting - no dedicated Diwali/Christmas/Festive nav node currently live) and the 'Gifting' mega-menu (only promotes Anniversary/Women/Men/price-tier tiles, no occasion list). No single 'Diwali' or 'Festive' root category exists on the live site; a legacy /collections/diwali-collection URL 301-redirects to /collections/gifts-for-anniversary, confirming no live Diwali hub. PARTICULAR DILIGENCE ON DIWALI (per task instruction): found 12 Diwali-slugged or Diwali-tagged collections. Verified each individually via rendered HTML (title/H1/displayed 'N products' count) plus /collections/<handle>/products.json for exact qty and product-tag context (tags visible in the storefront's own product JSON, e.g. 'Diwali_Showpieces', 'Fountains_Diwali', 'Diwali_votives', 'Diwali_new' - not customer-facing filter facets, no visible 'Occasion' filter UI found). RESULT: diwali-scented-candles, diwali-glassware, diwali-canister, diwali-party-essentials, diwali-cookware, diwali-cutlery-sets, lanterns-for-diwali, festive-lights, celebrate-in-style-decor/-lighting/-kitchen/-aroma, festive-season-offer-on-furniture all return 0 products right now (2026-09-04, ~7 weeks pre-Diwali) - real, live, HTTP 200 taxonomy nodes but excluded since they fail the 'lists products' PLP requirement (rules SS1.3); diwali-canister's H1/title has also been fully repurposed to 'Canisters for Christmas Cookies', confirming these are recycled/reused collection-handle infrastructure, not a stable live Diwali branch. INCLUDED (6 rows, all flagged MANUAL REVIEW): diwali-show-pieces (30), fountains-for-diwali-ambience (7), diwali-votives (3), festive-lighting (2), festive-fragrances (13), celebrate-in-style (24) - each has real product inventory and either an explicit 'diwali' URL slug or 100%-Diwali-tagged product sample (celebrate-in-style: 24/24 sampled products tagged 'Diwali_new'; festive-lighting: 2/2 tagged 'Diwali_Lights'; festive-fragrances: 5/5 sampled tagged Diwali-prefixed tags), but the customer-visible H1/title text on every one of these 6 pages uses generic wording ('Festive Votives', 'Festive Lighting', 'Festive Fragrances', 'Celebrate in Style', 'Show Pieces for Gifting', 'Fountains For Indoors & Outdoors') rather than a literal on-page 'Diwali' label - flagged per rules SS3's explicit Diwali/Festive-ambiguity guidance rather than silently decided either way. EXCLUDED as non-genuine or off-boundary: secret-santa-gifts (53 products, name implies Christmas but its own products.json shows 100% tagged 'Festive Decor' and 30/53 literally 'Diwali_Showpieces' - identical product set family to diwali-show-pieces, i.e. a mislabeled/reused smart-collection, not genuine Christmas content); ganesh-festive-offers (2 products) and republic-day-offer (4 products) - both titled '...Offer', storewide-discount framing on a festival/national-day pretext, not a curated festival PLP (rules SS4 sale-page exclusion); gifting-by-occasions (832 products) - a cross-occasion umbrella hub (birthday/anniversary/wedding/festival gifts all mixed), not tied to one specific holiday; wedding-gifts, birthday-gifts, anniversary, gifts-for-housewarming - personal life-event gift categories, not calendar-based seasonal/holiday events (rules SS3 lists 'Wedding Season' as a seasonal shopping period, which this Wedding Gifts page is not); festive-collection (42 products) - actual on-page title/H1 is 'Home Makeover Sale', a mislabeled/reused handle, no seasonal content; school-kit/school-bottles/school-backpacks - plain kids-gear product-type categories with no 'Back to School' seasonal framing anywhere on-page, and all 0 products. NO Christmas/Xmas dedicated collection exists anywhere in the sitemap (only decorative 'xmas-summary/xmas-btn' CSS classes on the generic 'Sale' nav item for seasonal site theming, not a Christmas category); the diwali-canister handle is now literally Christmas-cookie-canister branded but has 0 products so is excluded either way. No Halloween, Holi, Raksha Bandhan/Rakhi, Eid, Navratri, Dussehra, Janmashtami, Pongal, Onam, Durga Puja, Karwa Chauth, Makar Sankranti, or Baisakhi taxonomy found anywhere (sitemap grep + nav check, both clean). CORRECTION (orchestrator verify pass, 2026-09-04): the worker's original pass included 4 additional rows - Mother's Day (2479 products, ~67% of catalog), Father's Day (415 products, ~11%), Valentine's Day (193 products, ~5%), Summer Collection (232 products) - all unflagged, verified only by H1/title-match with no product-content sampling, unlike the parallel scrutiny correctly applied to the Diwali candidates in this same file. Orchestrator sampled 20-30 products from each via /collections/<handle>/products.json: all four are plain generic home-decor/furnishing assortments (water fountains, canisters, cushion covers, wall mirrors, wall art, showpieces, canvas wall paintings, photo frames, wine/cocktail glassware, floral placemats and trivets) with ZERO products carrying any occasion-specific character (no personalized items, no 'World's Best Dad/Mom' framing, no hearts/romantic framing, nothing gift-occasion-coded at all) - this is the same 'entire generic catalog mislabeled under a holiday/season URL' pattern that SR229 Vaaree and SR240 Pure Home + Living (same batch) correctly excluded elsewhere. All 4 rows removed; only the 6 content-verified (backend-tag-sampled) Diwali rows above survive. No New Year, Easter, Thanksgiving found in taxonomy (checked sitemap + nav, absent).
